For a classic cheesecake, the best substitute for cream cheese is mascarpone cheese. It has a similar rich, creamy texture and mild tang, though it is slightly richer and less tangy. To mimic the flavor profile of cream cheese more closely, you can mix mascarpone with a small amount of lemon juice or plain Greek yogurt. Another option is a blend of full-fat cottage cheese (blended until completely smooth) and a little butter, which can approximate the texture if you are looking for a lower-fat alternative, though the taste will be different.
